column_title: The Angelic Functions in the World of Yetzirah.
row_meaning: Ain — the Negative above the Tree (no attribution possible)
notes: Rows 2-10 hold the seraphim functions (Isaiah 6); rows 0 and 1 are both blank by design. The functions proclaim the Holy One's glory — they belong to the manifested order; Ain has no function.

column_title: Contents of Col. XCIV. (Heavens of Assiah)
row_meaning: Ain — the Negative above the Tree
notes: Rows 2-10 hold the heavens' contents (blessings snow angels singing...); rows 0 and 1 blank by design. Assiah is the created material world; the Negative contains nothing of it.

row_meaning: Ain — the Negative above the Tree
notes: Rows 1-10 hold the ten archangels (Metatron ... Sandalphon); row 0 blank by design. Ten archangels for ten Sephiroth; Ain has no archangel.

column_title: The Ten Divisions of the Body of God.
row_meaning: Ain — the Negative above the Tree
notes: Rows 1-10 hold the ten divisions (Skull ... Crown which is in Yesod); row 0 blank by design. Ten divisions for ten Sephiroth; Ain is not a division of the Body.

column_title: The Ten Hells in Seven Palaces.
row_meaning: Ain — the Negative above the Tree
notes: Rows 2-10 hold the hells (Sheol ... Gehinnom); rows 0 and 1 blank by design. Hells are post-creation stations; Ain has no hell.

row_meaning: Ain — the Negative above the Tree
notes: Rows 1-10 hold the ten alchemical stations (H F G = ! % & $ #); row 0 blank by design. Alchemy works on manifest matter; the Alchemical Tree has exactly ten stations.

row_meaning: Ain — the Negative above the Tree
notes: Rows 1-10 hold the Hindu soul-vehicles (Atma ... Sthula Sharira); row 0 blank by design. The vehicles map the manifested principles; Ain has no vehicle.

row_meaning: Ain — the Negative above the Tree
notes: Rows 1-10 hold the magical images (Ancient bearded king...); row 0 blank by design. The images are FORMS of the Sephiroth; Ain is formless — 'no image' is itself the answer. Discarded D2: a '-' string would encode intentionality as false data.

row_meaning: Ain — the Negative above the Tree
notes: Rows 1-10 hold the ten plagues (Death of First-born at row 1 ... Murrain at row 10); row 0 blank by design. Ten plagues for ten Sephiroth; Ain has no plague.

row_meaning: Ain — the Negative above the Tree
notes: Rows 1-10 hold the English renderings (Dual contending Forces ... The Evil Woman); row 0 blank by design. The title itself scopes Lines 1-10; Col. VIII has no row-0 order to translate.

column_title: Meaning of Col. CXXVII. (Seven Heavens of the Arabs)
row_meaning: Ain — the Negative above the Tree
notes: Rows 2-10 hold the heaven-meanings (House of Glory made of pearls ...); rows 0 and 1 blank by design. The Arab heavens are created stations; Ain is not a heaven.

row_meaning: Row 1 = Kether = Ace of Wands (the Root of the Powers of Fire)
notes: Angel pairs (lawhw laynd ...) appear on rows 2-10 ONLY; rows 0 1 and 11-32 all blank. The nine pairs rule the nine decan small cards; the Ace (row 1) is ruled by the god-name alone never by angel pairs (cf. CXXXIII/1 'The Root of the Powers of Fire'). A proposed pair would contradict the column's own logic.

column_title: Titles and Attributions of the Sword Suit [Spades]
row_meaning: Ain — the Negative above the Tree
notes: Rows 1-10 hold the sword titles (Root of the Powers of Air ... Ruin); row 0 blank by design. The Tarot has no card for Ain; no suit title applies to the Negative.
